description: Launch (or focus) the AudioEye-controlled Chrome window with a persistent profile. Optionally navigate to a URL. Use this first when the user needs to authenticate before scanning — the browser stays open so the user can log in interactively, and the profile persists across MCP sessions so subsequent scans skip login. Idempotent.

url.description: Optional URL to navigate to after the browser is open.

name: audioeye_open_browser
